title: [Tempest Queen, Stateroom]
description: Fine linen curtains frame an overlarge porthole in the wall above a carved mahogany bed featuring a plump, feather-stuffed mattress.  Partially concealed by a silk-screened partition, a bar of fragrant cedarwood soap floats on the surface of a water-filled, copper tub next to a small stool piled high with plush cotton towels.  A crumpled pamphlet lies on top of a polished mahogany night stand, an open drawer revealing a cut glass decanter and a shot glass of whiskey.
